data.title: One River Point
data.about:
Prepare to be captivated by One River Point in Business Bay—an architectural gem that proudly gazes upon the mesmerizing Dubai Canal and the iconic Burj Khalifa. Its design is more than just aesthetics; it's a perfect blend of elegance, innovation, and a profound connection to the vibrant urban landscape. 

Ellington's One River Point introduces a remarkable selection of premium studios and 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments, inviting you to make this extraordinary place your home. Living at One River Point means immersing yourself in a world where contemporary aesthetics, cutting-edge technology, and an unparalleled location combine to offer you a lifestyle that weaves together paths of opportunity and rejuvenation. Don't let this exceptional opportunity slip away—seize the chance to elevate your living experience at One River Point!

• An architectural marvel
  • Residences overlooking Dubai Canal and Burj Khalifa
  • 10,549 Sqft of world-class amenities
  • Public and F&B Spaces
  • High-end interiors and striking facades
  • Smart home automation
  • Integrated kitchen with a drop-in sink
  • Situated in a prime location
  • Premium Penthouses and Duplexes

location_tile.title: Perfectly Located in Business Bay
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Located within the vibrant Dubai, One River Point at Business Bay finds itself at the epicenter of innovation and aspiration. This dynamic district beckons with an array of enticing dining venues, a thriving art scene, and vibrant social spots. With its picturesque canalside settings and a comprehensive selection of fitness amenities, residents of One River Point at Business Bay are afforded the exclusive privilege of immersing themselves in Dubai's vast array of opportunities.

  • Dubai Water Canal Boardwalk - 01 Minute
  • Business Bay Marina - 05 Minutes
  • Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall - 07 Minutes
  • DIFC - 10 Minutes
  • Mall of Emirates - 15 Minutes
